Walkthrough
This pull request adds a Minecraft Bedrock add-on with three Lucky Block tiers, 90 registered outcomes, player progression, persisted rewards, and world-safety checks. It also adds pack assets, build and validation tools, automated tests, CI, and documentation that records verification status and release requirements. **Changes: Lucky Chaos add-on** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Event data and weighted selection**
`src/events/*`, `src/config/probabilities.*`, `packs/behavior_pack/scripts/events/*`, `packs/behavior_pack/scripts/config/*`, `src/core/random.js`, `tools/probability-test.mjs`, `tools/generate-catalog.mjs`, `EVENT_CATALOG.md`, `evidence/probability.json`, `tests/core.test.mjs`, `tests/events.test.mjs`|Defines bilingual event records and tier weights. Adds seeded event selection, probability sampling, catalog generation, and event-coverage checks.| |**Progression and persisted state**
`src/core/*`, `packs/behavior_pack/scripts/core/*`, `tests/activation.test.mjs`, `tests/bosses.test.mjs`, `tests/persistence.test.mjs`, `tests/terrain-journal.test.mjs`|Adds state encoding, progression, activation claims, persisted boss rewards, and a bounded terrain journal. Adds tests for state migration, reward limits, and journal behavior.| |**Event operations and world safety**
`src/runtime/operations.js`, `packs/behavior_pack/scripts/runtime/operations.js`, `tests/runtime-events.test.mjs`, `tests/world-safety.test.mjs`, `evidence/event-results.json`|Adds reward, entity, terrain, prank, boss, and structure handlers. Adds protected-block checks, conditional restoration, and operation limits. Runtime smoke tests record event results with a source hash.| |**Activation and player flows**
`src/main.js`, `packs/behavior_pack/scripts/main.js`|Connects block activation to weighted outcomes and progression. Adds menus, operator settings, arena checks, boss-reward delivery, and world-load handling.| |**Pack definitions and presentation**
`packs/behavior_pack/blocks/*`, `packs/behavior_pack/items/*`, `packs/behavior_pack/manifest.json`, `packs/resource_pack/*`, `tools/generate_assets.py`, `evidence/asset-reproducibility.sha256`|Adds pack manifests, blocks, items, English and Vietnamese text, texture mappings, sound definitions, and an asset-generation tool.| |**Build and automated checks**
`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tools/*`, `.github/workflows/audit.yml`, `evidence/*`|Adds build, packaging, validation, probability, benchmark, and reproducibility scripts. Adds an audit workflow and reports for build, validation, dependency audit, performance, and reproducibility.| |**Usage and release records**
`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `COMPATIBILITY.md`, `DESIGN_LOG.md`, `FAILURE_LEDGER.md`, `RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`, `TEST_PLAN.md`, `docs/FINAL_RELEASE_AUDIT.md`, `evidence/README.md`, `evidence/source-audit.md`|Documents installation, compatibility, design, reported findings, test procedures, verification limits, and release gates.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~60 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Player participant mainjs participant selectEvent participant EventOperations participant Progression Player->>mainjs: Break a supported lucky block mainjs->>selectEvent: Select an event using tier weights selectEvent-->>mainjs: Return the selected event mainjs->>EventOperations: Run the event handler mainjs->>Progression: Record discovery and award XP EventOperations-->>Player: Apply the event outcome ```
